development_gate.winner_rule: Among selection-eligible thresholds passing every condition, choose highest +1c stressed pooled mean P&L per event; exact tie chooses the higher threshold.

development_scope.block_order_rule: sort unique events by event_close_time_utc ascending, then event_ticker ascending

future_c1_c2_confirmation.authorization_condition: Only after one development threshold is selected and its result is frozen/closed.

future_c1_c2_confirmation.failure_consequence: Reject quoted-entry hold Strategy-v1 family; no repair/retune on C1+C2.

future_c1_c2_confirmation.C1: Champion-R0 probabilities frozen before C1 outcomes
future_c1_c2_confirmation.C2: Champion-R1 probabilities frozen before C2 outcomes

historical_probability_provenance.rule: Use only the original frozen out-of-sample/OOF Candidate-E lifecycle predictions for each historical stage; never recompute Champion-Final probabilities on fit events.

metrics.maximum_drawdown_rule: Chronological cumulative event P&L including abstentions as zero; initial peak is 0.

strategy_policies.entry_selection: exact 21N-A first-qualifying-anchor selection; do not reselect trades after outcomes are opened
strategy_policies.five_cent_reason: Outcome-independent audit produced only 33 development entries; it may be scored diagnostically but may not become the selected Strategy-v1 threshold.
strategy_policies.position_policy: hold selected side to settlement; no early exit, re-entry, adding, averaging, side switching, stops, targets, or sizing optimization

stress_policy.interpretation: Sensitivity analysis only; not an empirical slippage, depth, queue, or latency estimate.
stress_policy.invalid_price_rule: If stressed price is outside [0,1], mark that threshold stress scenario invalid as a whole; do not cap, omit, interpolate, or impute the trade.
